channel.title: Security Brief
channel.description: Original analysis and ranked cybersecurity news with links to original sources

item.title: BeyondTrust Remote Support Zero-Day Continues Trend of Exploited Edge Bugs
item.description: Ivanti, Cisco, and Palo Alto Networks all had vulnerabilities in edge devices come under fire this week. Now BeyondTrust joins the group.

item.title: ConnectWise suspends Cloud Backup service after supply chain attack
item.description: ConnectWise initially said on Friday that it was investigating “attempts of unauthorized access associated with the ConnectWise Cloud Backup environment,” and confirmed such access on Saturday.

item.title: Microsoft Patches More Than 1,400 Security Flaws
item.description: Microsoft today issued updates to fix more than 1,400 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and other software. Today’s epic patch batch dwarfs September’s record of nearly 1,000 fixes, which was already about ten times the normal monthly patch load from Redmond. Just one of the weaknesses patched…

item.title: CVE-2026-80092 Microsoft Identity Web Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
item.description: Updated the Security Updates table to list Microsoft Identity Web v3 and v4 separately and clarify the affected version ranges. The existing security updates are versions 3.16.0 and 4.16.1, respectively. This is an informational change only.

item.title: [NEU] [hoch] Microsoft Edge: Mehrere Schwachstellen ermöglichen Codeausführung
item.description: Ein entfernter, anonymer Angreifer kann mehrere Schwachstellen in Microsoft Edge ausnutzen, um beliebigen Programmcode auszuführen.

item.title: Researchers Infiltrate Microsoft Tech Support Scam Operation
item.description: A large-scale scam operation impersonating Microsoft uses a malicious traffic distribution system (TDS) run by a Russian organization and abuses thousands of Cloudflare links.

item.title: ConnectWise Disables Cloud Backups Amid Concerns for Downstream MSPs
item.description: Researchers say attackers authenticated into Microsoft 365 tenants using ConnectWise credentials; ConnectWise says customer impact remains unconfirmed.

item.title: OpenCode hack exposes API keys amid AI distillation attacks
item.description: The open-source AI coding project OpenCode has notified a small number of users that API keys they used with external providers were exposed in a security breach.

item.title: CVE-2026-70197 .NET Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
item.description: Microsoft is aware that the vulnerability for which this CVE was assigned has not been addressed. We are working to prepare and test a complete mitigation. We will update this document when there is more information.

item.title: Microsoft fixes classic Outlook bug that hid Copilot buttons
item.description: Microsoft has fixed a known issue that removed the Copilot Chat and Copilot buttons in the classic Outlook desktop mail client for some Windows users.

item.title: PEERSTITCH Malware Deployed via FortiOS Flaw Bypasses Checks on Tagged VPN Sessions
item.description: A suspected advanced threat actor has been observed exploiting a security flaw in Fortinet FortiOS to deliver a previously unreported memory-resident ARM64 malware known as PEERSTITCH. The attack involves the exploitation of CVE-2025-61624 (CVSS score: 5.4), a path traversal flaw in the command line interpreter of…

item.title: Palo Alto Networks Patches PAN-OS Authenticated RCE Flaw Amid Active Exploitation
item.description: Palo Alto Networks on Wednesday issued security updates for a high-severity flaw in PAN-OS software that has come under active exploitation. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-0322 (CVSS score: 8.6), is a case of remote code execution in the management interface. "A remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability in the…

item.title: AhsayCBS Flaws Exploited to Deploy Web Shells Get New Fixes After Incomplete Patches
item.description: Singapore-based Ahsay Backup has released security updates to address two security flaws in AhsayCBS that have been exploited by bad actors to drop web shells and XMRig cryptocurrency miners. The vulnerabilities in question are CVE-2026-105133 and CVE-2026-105134, which could be chained to sidestep authentication and…

item.title: Ivanti ICS Zero-Day Attacks Highlight Vendor Patching Hurdles
item.description: CVE-2026-104935, a high-severity authentication bypass + RCE vulnerability, was only partially discovered and patched in July, leaving an opening for threat actors to capitalize on.

item.title: Police arrest Qilin ransomware suspect on holiday, as links made to Synnovis hack that contributed to patient’s death
item.description: A 28-year-old Russian man has been arrested by German police, suspected of being a key member of the Qilin ransomware gang. Detectives have linked the man to the attack against blood-testing firm Synnovis, that disrupted London hospitals, and resulted in the death of a patient. Read more in my article on the Hot for…

item.title: 970,000 Medi-Cal Members Affected by Paradigm Healthcare Data Breach
item.description: Paradigm Healthcare Services detected an intrusion in October 2025, but it took nearly a year to start notifying affected individuals. The post 970,000 Medi-Cal Members Affected by Paradigm Healthcare Data Breach appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: Nikkei discloses third data breach in a month, 1.8M records exposed
item.description: Nikkei Inc. disclosed a new data breach, the third in about a month, that exposed 1.83 million personal information records.

item.title: Siemens Software Center Vulnerability Exploited in ClickFix Malware Attacks
item.description: Attackers paired a genuine, signed copy of Siemens Software Center with malicious DLLs to infect Windows PCs via ClickFix lures. The post Siemens Software Center Vulnerability Exploited in ClickFix Malware Attacks appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: Drupal Warns of Fast Exploitation Risk for Critical Core RCE Flaw
item.description: Critical flaws impact the Entity List and Field UI modules, and exploit paths exist with contributed modules. The post Drupal Warns of Fast Exploitation Risk for Critical Core RCE Flaw appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: Microsoft fixes game, app crashes caused by recent Windows update
item.description: Microsoft has resolved a bug that caused games and apps using AC-3 (Dolby Digital) audio decoding to crash after installing the September 2026 Windows 11 preview update (KB5124010).

item.title: F5 releases out-of-band patches for critical NGINX vulnerabilities
item.description: F5 has released out-of-band security patches to address multiple NGINX web server flaws, including three critical-severity vulnerabilities that can let attackers execute code on vulnerable systems.

item.title: Feds Suspect Ransom Negotiator Ran ShinyHunters Extortion Site
item.description: U.S. federal investigators pursuing the ShinyHunters hacking group that recently stole highly sensitive data from the FBI have identified executives at two different ransomware negotiation firms who maintained unusually close relations with the extortion group, KrebsOnSecurity has learned. Sources close to the…

item.title: Fake Web3 Accelerator Uses npm Packages to Spread Malware and Hijack AI Agent Traffic
item.description: A fake Web3 accelerator has been observed pushing information stealers and backdoors to Windows and macOS systems using malicious npm packages under the pretext of offering free artificial intelligence (AI) credits for Anthropic Claude and Google Gemini, coding tools, and security audits. item.title: OpenCode Console Breach May Have Exposed OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google API Keys
item.description: An intruder reached a legacy system at OpenCode on the night of October 16 and may have exposed the third-party AI provider keys that users had saved in OpenCode Console, the company said. Console is OpenCode's optional hosted service: a workspace saves its own OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google key there, and Console uses…

item.title: When Your Ransomware Negotiator Works for the Other Side
item.description: The shocking arrest of a well-known ransomware negotiator reveals the critical need for vendor program oversight.
